mainSet.name: 25-Min Recovery Shakeout
mainSet.description: Jog very easily for 25 minutes continuously.

coachingNotes: This should feel like a slow, relaxed jog. Speed is irrelevant today.
Check your heart rate periodically. Keep it strictly easy.
commonMistakes: Turning a recovery day into a moderate aerobic run.

Do not run through muscular strain on recovery days.
